title: Glimmerfox
html:
A level 41 Moonbeast that attacks with stab (melee).

Fighting it

Weak crushshock   Resists slashfreeze

A weakness adds 30% damage and a resistance takes 30% off (the game's own rule).

Reagent: Moonhart Antler (infuses an enchant). A small chance on any kill, far better from elites. Reforging

Levels

All levelsLv 41 16Lv 42 22

The same monster spawns at different levels, and its hitpoints, damage and XP follow its level (the game’s own formula). In the game a monster more than 5 levels above you shows its level as “???”.
